productsPage.title: Period Products Guide
productsPage.sub: Learn about sanitary pads, menstrual cups, tampons, and reusable products with safety and hygiene tips.
productsPage.padsDesc: Most common soft absorbency pads for all flow levels. Change every 4-6 hours.
productsPage.cupsDesc: Eco-friendly medical silicone cup reusable for up to 10 years. Wear up to 12 hours.
productsPage.tamponsDesc: Internal absorbent cotton plug ideal for swimming & active sports.
productsPage.periodPantsDesc: Washable leak-proof absorbent underwear for light to medium flow days.
productsPage.discDesc: Flat-fit disc seated in vaginal fornix with up to 12h high-capacity protection.
productsPage.hygieneTipDesc: Always wash hands before and after changing any period product to prevent infection.
